subtitle: Customise how your wolf pet looks!
description:
Pick its texture from the game's own two wolves, every Minecraft Java wolf variant, or the skeleton wolf from Minecraft Earth. Give it a collar in any colour, or no collar at all, and put Minecraft Java wolf armor on it, dyed any colour and as cracked as you like.

Everything is set in the Mods tab of the game's settings, next to a 3D preview of your wolf that you can click and drag to turn.

Requirements

  • Blueprint Loader, which loads this mod

Install

  1. Close the game, and fully close the Minecraft Launcher if you use it.
  2. Open your Minecraft Dungeons II Paks folder.
    • Steam: Right click the game in your library, then Manage > Browse local files, then open Dungeons\Content\Paks
    • Minecraft Launcher: C:\XboxGames\Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks
    If you picked a different install folder in the Minecraft Launcher, it is Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks inside that folder.
  3. Create a folder called ~mods inside the Paks folder if there is not one already.
  4. Open the zip and move the WolfPetCustomiser folder inside it into ~mods, so the files end up like this: Paks\~mods\WolfPetCustomiser\WolfPetCustomiser_P.pak

Uninstall

Delete the WolfPetCustomiser folder from ~mods.
